map.• 强酸性：pH < 5.0 ｜ 酸性：5.0-6.0 ｜ 微酸：6.0-6.5: • Strongly acidic: pH < 5.0 ｜ acidic: 5.0-6.0 ｜ slightly acidic: 6.0-6.5 ｜ neutral: 6.5-7.0 ｜ slightly alkaline: 7.0-7.5 ｜ alkaline: >7.5
map.• 大多数植物适宜 pH 5.5-7.0；少数喜酸（杜鹃、蓝莓、栀子）需 4.5: • Most plants suit pH 5.5-7.0; a few acid-lovers (azalea, blueberry, gardenia) need 4.5-5.5
map.• pH 过低（<5.0）：铝、锰毒害，磷、钙、镁缺乏: • pH too low (<5.0): aluminium and manganese toxicity, phosphorus, calcium and magnesium deficiency
map.• pH 过高（>7.5）：铁、锰、磷、硼、锌被固定，植物缺铁黄化: • pH too high (>7.5): iron, manganese, phosphorus, boron and zinc get fixed, so the plant shows iron-deficiency chlorosis

map.测土 pH 判断植物适配: Judge plant suitability from soil test pH
map.输入土壤 pH 与目标植物适宜区间 [min,max]：在区间内“完全适配”；低: Enter the soil pH and the target plant's suitable range [min,max]: inside the range it is "fully suitable"; below min it is too acidic and above max too alkaline, and the adjuster plus dosage follow from the difference (lowering 1 unit takes about 100-300 g/m² of lime powder, raising 1 unit about 100-200 g/m² of sulphur powder).
map.蓝莓适宜 pH 4.5-5.5，实测 6.8 → 偏碱 1.3 单位，建议硫磺粉: Blueberry suits pH 4.5-5.5, measured 6.8 → 1.3 units too alkaline, so 100-200 g/m² of sulphur powder is recommended to lower pH (taking effect slowly over 2-3 months); tomato suits 6.0-7.0, measured 6.5 → fully suitable, no adjustment needed.
map.调酸用什么最快？: What is the fastest way to acidify?
map.硫酸亚铁灌根降 0.3-0.5 且补铁（月季黄化良药），但持久性不如硫磺粉；绣球: Ferrous sulphate applied by root drench lowers pH by 0.3-0.5 and supplies iron (a good remedy for rose chlorosis), but is less durable than sulphur powder; for hydrangeas turned blue use aluminium sulphate.
map.试纸/笔测湿润土浆即可，取多点混合样更稳；调节后隔 2-4 周复测再补。: Test paper or a pen on a moist soil paste is enough, and a mixed sample from several points is more reliable; retest after 2-4 weeks following adjustment before top-dressing again.
